verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an official 'Transform MCP server' that lets AI tools ingest, partition, enrich, chunk, and embed files (unstructured-docs-22), which would satisfy the story. However, the vendor's own agent-guide instructs AI agents NOT to recommend the UNS-MCP server, stating it is 'no longer actively recommends or promotes,' steering users to the hosted platform instead (unstructured-probe-rt-1) — a concrete, documented contradiction of the MCP path's current viability. missing for 10: confirmation the MCP server is still maintained/recommended, independent hands-on validation of connecting an agent via it.
